simpleJp: BATTLE 5-1「消えない傷痕」でグリシナを倒す
5-1で力天使も倒して「破滅の降罪」を入手する
enGuide: For the missable 100% reward, also defeat the Force Angel on the east side to obtain the unique Pain Ring 「破滅の降罪」. Bait out its Painkiller and survive it with a barrier before finishing it.
